⇒ A = 8800

questions.solution:
**Given:**

√(cosecx – 1)/√(cosecx + 1) 

**Trigonometry identities used:**

sin²x + cos²x = 1

**Formula used:**

 a² – b² = (a + b) (a – b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ √(cosecx – 1)/√(cosecx + 1) 

(Here cosecx = 1/sinx

⇒ √[(1/sinx) – 1]/√[(1/sinx) + 1]

⇒ √(1 – sinx)/√(1 + sinx)

Rationalization

⇒ [√(1 – sinx)/√(1 + sinx)] × [√(1 – sinx)/√(1 – sinx)] 

⇒ √(1 – sinx)²/√(1 + sinx) (1 – sinx)

Here a² – b² = (a + b) (a – b)

⇒ (1 – sinx)/√(1 – sin²x)

Here 1 – sin²x = cos²x

⇒ (1 – sinx)/√cos²x

⇒ (1 – sinx)/cosx

⇒ (1/cosx) – (sinx/cosx)

Here 1/cosx = secx, sinx/cosx = tanx

⇒ secx – tanx ** 

∴ The required answer is __secx - tanx__**

questions.question: The marked price of a toy is Rs. 450. After a certain discount on the marked price, the selling price of the toy is Rs. 405. The rate of discount is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price (M.P.) of toy = 450

Selling Price (S.P.) of toy = 405

**Formula used:**

Discount percentage = [(Marked price – Selling price)/Marked price] × 100

**Calculation:**

M.P. = 450

S.P. = 405

Discount % = [(450 – 405)/450] × 100

⇒ (45/450) × 100

⇒ 10%

**∴**** The rate of discount is 10%.**

questions.question: Which number is divisible by both 9 and 11?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

**Divisibility rule of 9:**

A number is divisible by 9 only when the sum of its digits is divisible by 9.

10098 → 1 + 0 + 0 + 9 + 8 = 18

10108 → 1 + 0 + 1 + 0 + 8 = 10

10089 → 1 + 0 + 0 + 8 + 9 = 18

10087 → 1 + 0 + 0 + 8 + 7 = 16

10098 and 10089 are the numbers that satisfy the condition 

**Divisibility rule of 11:**

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of its digits at odd places and the sum of its digits at even places is either 0 or a number divisible by 11

In case of 10098

⇒ (1 + 0 + 8) – (0 + 9) = 9 – 9 = 0 (Satisfying the condition)

Checking second term 10089

⇒ (1 + 0 + 9) – (0 + 8) = 9 – 8 = 1 (Not satisfying the condition)

**∴**** The number which is divisible by both 9 and 11 is 10098.**

questions.question: A car covers 15 km, 20 km, 30 km and 12 km at speeds of 20 km/h, 30 km/h, 40 km/h and 30 km/h respectively. The average speed of the car for the total journey is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A car covers 15 km, 20 km, 30 km and 12 km at speeds of 20 km/h, 30 km/h, 40 km/h and 30 km/h respectively.

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total distance/Total time taken

Time taken = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:**

Time taken to cover 15 km at speed of 20 km/hr = 15/20 = 3/4 hours

Time taken to cover 20 km at speed of 30 km/hr = 20/30 = 2/3 hours

Time taken to cover 30 km at speed of 40 km/hr = 30/40 = 3/4 hours

Time taken to cover 12 km at speed of 30 km/hr = 12/30 = 2/5 hours

Total time taken = 3/4 + 2/3 + 3/4 + 2/5 = (45 + 40 +45 + 24)/60 = 154/60 = 77/30

The total Distance = 15 + 20 + 30 + 12 = 77

The average speed = 77/77 × 30 = 30 km/hr

**∴ The average speed of the car for total journey is 30km/hr.**

questions.question: The volume of a cube is 343 cm³. The edge of cube is:

⇒ a = 7 cm 

**∴ The edge of cube is 7 cm.**

questions.question: Each side of a rectangular field is increased by 10%. Then percentage increase in the area of the field is:
questions.solution:

Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth

Increased breadth = B + 10B/100

⇒ Increased breadth = 110B/100 = 1.1B

questions.question: if x³ - 6x² + ax + b is divisible by (x² - 3x + 2), then the values of a and b are:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Dividend = x3 - 6x2 + ax + b

Divisor = x2 - 3x + 2

**Concept used:**

Remainder theorem:** **It says if a polynomial is divided by (x – a), then remainder will be after substituting the value of [(x - a) = 0 ⇒ x = a] in given polynomial.

If a polynomial is dived by (x + a), then remainder will be after substituting the value of (x + a = 0 ⇒ x = - a) in given polynomial.

If a polynomial is divided by (ax + b), then remainder will be after substituting the value of [ax + b = 0 ⇒ ax = - b ⇒ x = (-b/a)] in given polynomial.

If a polynomial is divided by (ax - b), then remainder will be after substituting the value of [ax - b = 0 ⇒ ax = b ⇒ x = (b/a)] in given polynomial.

**Calculation:**

Divisor = x2 - 3x + 2

Now we calculate the factor of x2 - 3x + 2

Then, x2 - 3x + 2 = 0

⇒ x2 - 2x - x + 2 = 0

⇒ x(x - 2) - 1(x - 2) = 0

⇒ (x - 2)(x - 1) = 0

Then value of x will be (x - 2) = 0

⇒ x = 2

And the value of x will be also (x - 1) = 0

⇒ x = 1

Now the value of x is 2 and 1.

After putting of the value of x = 2 in the given dividend we get,

x3 - 6x2 + ax + b = 0

⇒ 2³ - 6 × 2² + a × 2 + b = 0

⇒ 8 - 24 + 2a + b = 0

⇒ 2a + b = 16 ----(i)

After putting of the value of x = 1 in the given dividend we get,

x3 - 6x2 + ax + b = 0

⇒ 13 - 6 × 12 + a × 1 + b = 0

⇒ 1 - 6 + a + b = 0

⇒ a + b = 5 ----(ii)

After subtracting of equation (ii) from equation (i), we get

2a - a = 16 - 5

⇒ a = 11

Using the value of a = 11 in equation (ii) we get,

11 + b = 5

⇒ b = 5 - 11

⇒ b = - 6

**∴ The value of a and b are 11 and - 6 respectively.**

questions.question: The measure of one of the exterior angles of a triangle is twice one of the interior opposite angles and the measure of the other interior opposite angles is 60º. The triangle is a/an:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The measure of one of the exterior angles = 2 × one of the interior opposite angles

The measure of other interior opposite angles = 60° 

**Concept used:**

Equilateral triangle: the measure of each interior angle is 60° 

Right-angle triangle: the measure of one of the interior angle should be 90° 

Scalene triangle: the measure of each angle is different.

Isosceles triangle: the measure of one of the two interior angles are equal.

The measure of one of the exterior angle = the sum of its opposite interior angles.

The sum of all interior angles in a triangle = 180° 

**Calculation:**

Let one of the interior opposites angles be x

The measure of one of the exterior angle = x + 60° 

⇒ 2 × one of the interior opposite angles = x + 60° 

⇒ 2x = x + 60° 

⇒ 2x - x = 60° 

⇒ x = 60° 

Now the third interior angle = 180° - x - 60° 

⇒ 180° - 60° - 60° 

⇒ 180° - 120° 

⇒ 60° 

Then we can see that each interior angle = 60° and this is possible when triangle will be an equilateral triangle.

**∴ The triangle is an Equilateral triangle.**
